It turns your Obsidian notes into a working surface "},{"id":"p3s2","text":"inside the chat window: look up SOPs,
keep a glossary, record meetings with live transcription and a"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"nnotations, and search everything."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"All files stay on your computer. No account, no telemetry. See PRIVACY.md."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"中文说明见 README.zh.md。"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"**Requires** a DSH installation (0.2.0 or newer — check with `dsh --version`) and network access
(th"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"e package comes from npm)."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Pick the command that matches your DSH:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"**DSH Desktop app**"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"**Self-hosted DSH Web** (on your server)"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Using a custom profile name? Replace `desktop` / `web` with yours (see `~/.dsh/profiles/`)."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Then **restart DSH** and click the workbench icon next to the session title, or press `⌥W`."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"No Obsidian required, no API keys, no account."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"> Fully verified on macOS only. Other platforms install and run, but the two actions that call
> sys"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"tem commands ("open in Obsidian", "open console") may need a config tweak."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## First run"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Click the workbench icon next to the session title (or press `⌥W`).
The first time, it asks for one "},{"id":"p18s2","text":"thing: the full path of a folder holding your Markdown notes
(an Obsidian vault, or any folder — the"},{"id":"p18s3","text":" plugin only touches `.md` files).
Fill it in and press save — that's it."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Nothing else is required. The optional extras (transcription, usage badges, Pkulaw points)
stay dorm"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"ant until you provide your own credentials."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## What you get"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| Card | What it does | Needs |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"| SOP | Browse your SOP folder as a tree, read and edit notes in place | a vault |
| Glossary | One "},{"id":"p22s2","text":"row per term, edit inline, written back to a note | a vault |
| Recordings | Record, transcribe live"},{"id":"p22s3","text":", highlight and annotate the transcript, play back | a vault; transcription needs a Volcengine key |"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"
| Search | Full-text search across notes, transcripts and annotations | a vault |
| Email | Draft e"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"mails from your own rule library | optional: your own skill folder |
| Usage badge | DeepSeek balanc"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"e and remaining speech hours | optional: your own keys |"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Where things live"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- Your notes and recordings: inside your vault (folders are configurable on the first screen).
- Plu"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"gin configuration: `~/.dsh-workbench/config.json`.
- Optional credentials: `~/.dsh-workbench/asr.jso"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"n` (mode 600, never in this repo)."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Keyboard"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"- `⌥W` — open or close the workbench wherever you are
- `Esc` — close it"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Notes"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"- The right sidebar is per-session in DSH. If the workbench cannot dock there, it opens as an
overla"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"y instead of failing silently.
- Transcription is off unless you configure a Volcengine key; recordi"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"ng and playback work without it."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Troubleshooting"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"- **The panel opens but stays empty**: click the **refresh** button at the top right of the panel.
T"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"his is a known first-load issue in 1.1.0; one refresh fixes it.
- **Clicking the icon does nothing**"},{"id":"p30s3","text":": some sessions have no right sidebar yet, so the workbench
opens as an overlay instead (shortcut `⌥"},{"id":"p30s4","text":"W`).
- **It asks you to configure something**: it just needs the folder holding your Markdown notes."},{"id":"p30s5","text":"you to configure something**: it just needs the folder holding your Markdown notes.
Fill it in once."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"- **Images in notes are not rendered.** They appear as a filename label (e.g. `图片 photo.png`).
Every"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"thing else in a note (headings, lists, bold, code, tables as text, wikilinks) is shown.
- Markdown s"},{"id":"p32s3","text":"upport is deliberately minimal: no HTML, no embedded PDFs, no mermaid rendering.
- Annotations ancho"},{"id":"p32s4","text":"r to the **first line** of a multi-line selection.
- Highlight colour is fixed (yellow); the storage"},{"id":"p32s5","text":" supports more, the UI does not expose it yet.
- The reimbursement card only checks that a template "},{"id":"p32s6","text":"exists; it does not parse it yet.
- Transcribing an imported audio file shows no progress bar.
- The"},{"id":"p32s7","text":" workbench reads and writes the vault directly. Edits made in Obsidian appear after a refresh,
and e"},{"id":"p32s8","text":"dits made here appear in Obsidian immediately (same files).
- DSH gives each session its own right s"},{"id":"p32s9","text":"idebar; if the workbench cannot dock there it opens as an
